sentences.text:
Prohibition Act vs In Re : Sahid Shah @ Babu @ Said Shah &
Anr on 19 May, 2023
Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak 19.05.2023 KAUSHIK Allowed C.R.M.(A) 2105 of 2023

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Bhagwangola Police Station Case No. 49 of 2023 dated 09.02.2023 under Sections 498A/494/323/325/307 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

And In Re : Sahid Shah @ Babu @ Said Shah & Anr.
...... petitioners Mr. S. Das Mahapatra Mr. Ali Ahsan Alamgir Ms. Soma Mal ....for the petitioners Mr. Imran Ali Ms. Sayanti Santra ....for the State Police filed charge-sheet.
This is the second police complaint, inter alia, under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
Apparently, an incident of assault took place where, two persons suffered injuries.
In respect of one of the injured, the injury was not classified as grievous.
The other suffered a fracture in the right ulna.
Considering the gravity of the offence and the involvement of the petitioners in the incident, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on condition that the petitioners shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioners in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
This application for anticipatory bail is, thus, allowed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
